name: Mai Season
source:
Main character spends his day lazily when the door bell starts to ring. The visitor is his younger sister who comes to live together with him for a while. What a bother... but maybe it turns out fun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公无所事事地打发日子时，门铃响了起来。
来访的是妹妹，她要和他暂住一阵子。
真麻烦……不过，或许也会很有意思。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
